fear: You hear slow footsteps behind you in a dark, empty alley, and they speed up when you do.
The plane suddenly drops and the oxygen masks fall from the ceiling.
You wake at night and see a stranger standing silently at the foot of your bed.
Your car's brakes stop working as you head down a steep, winding road.

You are lost in a forest at night and something large is moving through the trees near you.

Someone grabs your arm from behind in a crowded station.
You smell smoke and see flames under the door of your bedroom.
The lift jolts, the lights go out, and it begins to slide downwards.
A wave knocks you under and you cannot tell which way is up.
You get a message from an unknown number that says: I know where you live.
You are hiding in a cupboard while someone walks through your house calling your name.
The rope you are climbing on starts to fray above your hands.
